name: Contact form
description: The contact section: heading, introduction, contact details (email, phone, address) and a Contentrain Studio form — fields, spam protection and notifications set in Studio, submissions reviewed there. Replaces form plugins; renders the details alone until the site is bound to a Studio project. When the owner chose another home at migration (site.config.ts `features.forms`) the form posts to their form service, or the section shows an address to write to or a link to the form on WordPress.

layout.description: split: details beside the form on wide screens. stacked: one centred column.

tone.description: Section background; the form always sits on a surface card.

model.description: The Studio model submissions are saved to — the form's fields are that model's form settings (from the plugin form's fields at migration).

intro.label: Introduction
intro.description: A line or two above the details.

formHeading.label: Form heading
formHeading.description: The form's own heading, shown above the form.

details.label: Contact details

label.label: Label
label.description: What the detail is (Phone, Email, Address).

href.label: Link
href.description: A tel:, mailto: or map link for it.

details.description: Ways to reach you, in order (Email → mailto:, Phone → tel:, Address → map link).

a11y: Contact details are a description list; links say what they open. The form's labels, errors and focus handling are Studio's form runtime (FormMount). The section is labelled by its heading.
